name: packager
description: Build-time dependency resolution agent: installs dependencies in a confined sandbox and captures them so consumers run network-isolated; artifact layering proper lands with the Phase 6 artifact store.

unmappedExclusions.*: home excluded_tools is empty — the deny list is a pure dsh design decision: no AgentSpawn/AgentMessage at home (subagent/subagent_fork/send_message/interrupt_agent denied). Home holds NetworkAccess hosts *, but on dsh install egress is sandbox+approval-gated through the confined bash tool, so web_search/web_fetch stay denied and bash remains the install path — network-carrying installs ride the approval waterfall, not a browser tool.
